title: A Mammal Survives 18 Minutes With Zero Oxygen

scenes.text: This animal survives eighteen minutes with no oxygen.
It's the naked mole-rat, a small rodent that lives underground.
In a lab, scientists took away all the oxygen.
It passed out after thirty seconds, but its heart kept beating for eighteen minutes.
Its cells switch to burning fructose, a trick only plants were known to use.
Eighteen minutes with no air, and it woke up fine.

description:
Naked mole-rats survived 18 minutes with no oxygen in a 2017 study, by switching their metabolism to fructose.
They also survived five hours at five percent oxygen.
Could any other mammal do this?
first_comment: At five percent oxygen they lasted five hours, and a mouse lasted minutes. Which animal should we cover next?
